en.clawhub.market.label: ClawHub
en.clawhub.title: ClawHub
en.clawhub.thirdParty: ClawHub skills are third-party code from their publishers, not from skillshare. Read a skill before you install it. Each download must match the checksum in ClawHub's feed and passes skillshare's security audit before it is installed.
en.clawhub.refresh: Fetch the list from ClawHub again
en.clawhub.stale: ClawHub could not be reached, so this is the list fetched {date}. ({reason})
en.clawhub.feedInfo: Feed generated {generated}. It is fetched again after {expires}, or when you refresh it.
en.clawhub.trust.hint: How far ClawHub vouches for the publisher
en.clawhub.details.githubNote: skillshare installs this folder from GitHub at commit {commit}, once its files match the checksum in ClawHub's feed. The skill stays at that commit; install it again from here when ClawHub lists a newer one.
en.clawhub.blocked.unavailable: ClawHub lists this skill as unavailable.
en.clawhub.blocked.noIntegrity: ClawHub publishes no checksum for this release, so it cannot be checked and is not installed.
en.clawhub.blocked.unsupported: ClawHub offers no release of this skill that can be installed here.
en.clawhub.replace.title: Replace {name}?
en.clawhub.replace.message: A skill named {name} is already installed. Replacing it removes that copy and installs {id} {version} from ClawHub in its place.
en.clawhub.replace.messageGitHub: A skill named {name} is already installed. Replacing it removes that copy and installs {id} from GitHub at commit {commit} in its place.
en.clawhub.error.integrity: The download does not match the checksum in ClawHub's feed, so nothing was installed.
en.clawhub.error.unsafe: The skill's files are unsafe to install, so nothing was installed: {detail}
en.clawhub.error.noSkill: The skill has no SKILL.md at its top level, so nothing was installed.
en.clawhub.error.versionChanged: ClawHub now lists version {version}. Refresh the list and try again.
en.clawhub.error.notFound: ClawHub's feed no longer lists this skill. Refresh the list.
